description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 25.11.2024 to 01.12.2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any other specialized categories.
